scope_notes: We check rain, heat, cold, snow, wind and recent rain. We don't yet check thunderstorms, hail, freezing rain or ice, wildfire, air quality, coastal flooding, or geological hazards. For those, follow official warnings.
Thunderstorms are not checked. Storms are a major cause of weather deaths — follow official storm warnings.
The history data is a ~25 km grid and misses very local storms.
Groundtruth covers weather-driven hazards only. For landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes, check local civil protection and geological authorities.

reply.headline: High risk of feels-like heat in Kolkata, India on 31 May 2022.
why: Feels-like heat set the level, reaching 41 °C, at or above the 40 °C danger line.
Days with feels-like heat like this happen about 48 times a year here now.
That is 1.4 times more common here than in 1951–1980, when it was about 34 times a year.
reply.what_it_means: Avoid heavy exertion outdoors, drink water, and check on older or vulnerable people. Rain, snow and wind were not the concern: Normal wind for here (gusts up to 28 km/h). Check your official weather warnings, because Groundtruth never replaces them.
reply.sms: Kolkata, 31 May 2022: High risk of feels-like heat, 41 C. Avoid heavy exertion, drink water. Check your official weather warnings.
reply.confidence_note: Thunderstorms are not checked, and the history data is a grid of about 25 km that misses very local storms. Geological hazards such as landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes need local civil protection and geological authorities.
